about: Named WIND REGIMES: presets of the three inputs that set the wind's character (docs/RESEARCH_wind.md 13.3). intensity is 0..1, roughly Beaufort / 12, and sets the mean speed through wind.speed*Mul; gale and convective are 0..1 weights of the sustained-gale and thunderstorm characters. Sky presets (assets/weather/*.json) name one of these in their "wind" field and the sky's ladder blends them; wind.regime pins one directly (F1 -> Wind -> Weather). Add a regime by adding a row: nothing in C++ switches on a name.

regimes.name: calm
regimes.label: Calm
regimes.about: Near still. Smoke rises almost vertically, hollows go dead still, the heading wanders freely.

regimes.name: light
regimes.label: Light air
regimes.about: Light breeze. Leaves rustle; on a sunny day thermals and slope winds are as strong as the breeze itself.

regimes.name: breezy
regimes.label: Breezy
regimes.about: A gentle-to-moderate breeze, the default day: grass leaning and rippling, gust fronts crossing the meadow.

regimes.name: windy
regimes.label: Windy day
regimes.about: Fresh-to-strong breeze. Ridges noticeably windier, hollows still sheltered, gusts ~1.5x the mean.

regimes.name: gale
regimes.label: Gale
regimes.about: Sustained gale: a steady direction, gust factor ~1.5, turbulence in the lee of steep drops, sand on the move.

regimes.name: thunderstorm
regimes.label: Thunderstorm
regimes.about: A convective storm cycle: a calm lull, then the gust front (a direction jump and a 2-3x speed spike, downbursts), then gusty decay.
